svg.title: TikTok Events API match keys and where they come from
svg.desc: Four groups of match keys. The click ID, ttclid, is added to the landing page URL when someone clicks a TikTok ad and must be captured and forwarded. The _ttp first-party cookie is set by the Pixel on your domain. Email, phone and external ID must be hashed. IP address and user agent are shared automatically by the Pixel but need manual configuration for the Events API.
svg.text: Which match keys help TikTok connect a sale to an ad?
The Pixel collects some of these for you. For the Events API, you pass every key yourself.
Added to the landing URL on a TikTok ad click.
Capture it on landing and keep it until checkout.
First-party cookie the Pixel sets on your domain.
Forward its value with server events.
Where the customer gave them and consent allows.
Normalize first, per TikTok's developer docs.
Shared by default by the Pixel.
Manual setup for the Events API: send the visitor's,
More consented keys generally improve matching. Only collect and send what your privacy notice covers.
Source: TikTok Business Help Center, "How to set up matching events with Events API" and "About Events API".
